They omit fenced normative-lookalike and negative-example cases. Reviewer directly reproduced both missing boundaries; passing 298 tests does not establish these paths.

3 Edge cases — concern for parser fences; instructional paths pass independent manual tracing. CIM0/CIM1 select noncoverage/coverage review before provider or privilege, preserving read-only external/native/privileged review. CIM6 native authoring uses exact external contract plus independent risk/privilege evidence. CIM7 privileged create always loads risk/GitHub/skeleton/approval; CIM8 privileged revise adds coverage risk and structural skeleton independently. CIM2 ordinary create always maps risk; CIM5 structural revise precedes CIM4 coverage preserving revise and independently adds risk; CIM3 narrow preserving revise uses GitHub procedure only. Late coverage/structure reclassifies and loads before dependent action; late privilege denies absent approval, otherwise selects CIM7/8 or native CIM6 with approval.

4 Error handling — pass for skill; concern for reader. Unknown classifications, escaped/stale/ambiguous targets, unsupported primitives and external/unauthorized privileged mutation stop. Missing triggered resources stop without memory fallback; untriggered absence does not stop unrelated runtime work. New unknown-before-consistency ordering is correct for actual declaration rows, but fenced negative examples falsely raise unknown errors.

5 Architecture — pass. Risk map alone selects risk/check/boundary, GitHub reference serializes settled mapping and skeleton supplies structure. Full resource inspection confirms these duties. No runtime classifier, live CI, owning-policy or schema change. Current design-review-ci and delivery-review-ci approve exact current model/plan; older feasibility-source drift does not retarget those actual approval targets.

6 Compatibility — pass. Complete Bugfix entrypoint retained: diagnose-only versus fix, exact authority and governed-signal axes, ordered evidence/proof phases, supported-cause routing, proof-action table, identity-equal reruns and phase-specific write boundary serve distinct outcomes and should not be shortened away. CI atomic no-clobber/identity replacement, idempotency, independent/ordered/atomic batches, partial recovery and rebuilt retry manifests remain explicit. Historical short labels retain their original historical meaning; no alias or migration introduced.

7 Security/privacy — pass. Review supplies no mutation; command sources remain authoritative. Exact privileged Design/review binds target, events, credentials, permissions, runners and fork/secrets behavior. Bounded already-open PR repair retains current evidence/no-open-finding/authority preconditions and restore-only scope. No hosted success inferred.

8 Derived artifacts — pass within contributor evidence scope. m4-validation binds exact sources to fresh two-adapter build and clean-install CI proof plus full packaging95. Bugfix/shared package resources are unchanged. This first pass does not claim post-correction candidate currency.

9 Unrelated changes — pass. Diff e44d1b46..b33d0e94 changes CI entrypoint, its bounded validator and direct test consumers plus scoped governed evidence. Bugfix disposition is justified retention, not an unassessed omission; no other family implementation changed.

10 Validation evidence — concern limited to new regression gap.
